trigger: Run only after the official Kaggle file inventory changes on or after 2026-09-21.

trainable: organizer-provided unlabeled Phase 2 pixels for aggregate drift diagnostics only

requirements: every local official file matches its declared size and has a SHA-256 receipt
the union of training class IDs is contiguous and every per-file class subset is recorded
sample submission ID blocks are contiguous, zero based, and fully hashed
old Phase 1 encoder and head remain blocked unless the organizer supplies an explicit semantic class mapping

validation.block_construction: deterministic rectangular scene tiles; keep each tile wholly inside one fold; balance labeled class mass greedily
validation.fit_scope: all preprocessing, PCA, feature scaling, and class balancing are fit inside each training fold
reports: prediction coverage and class collapse checks

reference.name: phase2_retrained_spatial_mean_lightgbm
reference.definition: Retrain the frozen 3x3 spatial-mean LightGBM recipe from scratch on Phase 2 labels and the same Phase 2 folds.
reference.purpose: Same-data reference only; do not reuse Phase 1 weights or old 0.68814 OOF as a threshold.

first_candidate.name: pca_local_texture_lightgbm
first_candidate.single_scientific_change: replace raw 98-band tree input with fold-fit spectral PCA plus local spatial mean, local spatial standard deviation, and first spectral differences
first_candidate.classifier: class-balanced LightGBM with the reference tree budget and fixed seed
first_candidate.reason: Tests spectral compression and local texture jointly while keeping the classifier, folds, budget, and label policy fixed.

offline_go: candidate OA improves by at least 0.03 over the Phase 2 retrained reference
candidate AA improves by at least 0.03 over the Phase 2 retrained reference
worst spatial block OA and AA each decline by no more than 0.02
schema, hash, coverage, leakage, runtime, and class-collapse gates pass
go_no_go.offline_stop: If any offline GO condition fails, do not run full test inference and do not submit.
go_no_go.public_stop: First legal Phase 2 public score below 0.15 seals the line.
go_no_go.public_followup: A score at or above 0.20 permits exactly one independent spectral-spatial follow-up; 0.15 to 0.20 keeps the baseline but permits no expansion.
